description: This PHP class 'CommonMarkConverter' extends the 'MarkdownConverter' to set up and configure a CommonMark Markdown processing environment with various extensions, custom renderers, and parsers. It is part of a content rendering system within a static site generator or documentation tool.

classes.name: CommonMarkConverter
classes.description: A specialized MarkdownConverter for CommonMark that initializes the environment with specific extensions and renderers, facilitating customized Markdown processing within the application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CommonMarkConverter with a given configuration, setting up the Markdown environment with necessary extensions, custom renderers, and integrating with the Daux processing pipeline.

methods.name: extendEnvironment
methods.description: A placeholder method for further customization of the Markdown environment; currently does nothing.
